description: Preview of the Discord v10 HTTP API specification. See https://discord.com/developers/docs for more details.

novel_features.name: Guild snapshot
novel_features.description: One-call-batch guild inventory: name, member count, sorted channel tree with category labels, and role list with color and mentionable flags. Built for audits and agent-driven guild reports.

novel_features.name: Whois identity card
novel_features.description: Resolve a user id into a card: username, display name, bot flag, account creation date derived from the snowflake, plus guild nick, roles, and join date when --guild is given.

novel_features.name: Catch-up digest
novel_features.description: Per-channel new-message volume inside the window across every guild the bot can see (or one guild). Reads only; never marks anything read.

novel_features.name: Channel history digest
novel_features.description: Recent message digest for a channel: author, timestamp, type, and content, newest first. Read-only.
